description: Analyze cold outreach replies and craft the right response based on a relationship-first philosophy. Use when asked "how to reply to this", "they said X what do I say", "handle this objection", "got a response from a prospect", "interested reply", "not interested reply", "next step after reply", "competitor objection", "pricing question", or "how do I respond to this email/LinkedIn message". Always use this skill before writing any reply to a prospect.
